projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for rate-limiting focus area
acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'rate-limiting' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'rate-limiting'
Add stories US-62-002 through US-62-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code
IMPORTANT: All generated stories MUST have passes set to false - do NOT run tests or evaluate whether they already pass
IMPORTANT: Story IDs MUST follow format US-62-NNN to be unique across sprints
Mark this story (US-62-001) as passes: true when done
userStories.notes: Generated 11 stories (US-62-002 through US-62-012) for rate-limiting focus area based on user interview notes about caption format fallback inefficiency and codebase analysis of retry budget, circuit breaker, and escalation patterns.

userStories.title: Add pre-flight --list-subs check before caption format iteration
acceptanceCriteria: fetch_captions method calls _get_available_languages before iterating formats
_get_available_languages is cached per-video to avoid redundant yt-dlp calls
When --list-subs returns empty, method returns immediately with 'no captions' status
Logging shows 'Pre-flight: no captions available' when skipping format iteration
Test verifies single yt-dlp call for videos with no captions (was 4+ calls)
Test verifies format iteration proceeds normally when captions ARE available
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented: fetch_captions calls list_available_languages (line 4281), cached via ListSubsCache (line 2541-2554) and _preflight_lang_cache (line 4472-4475). Empty list-subs returns 'no captions' immediately (line 4286-4298). Log message at line 4498. Tests in test_caption_preflight.py and test_listsubs_cache.py (22 tests passing).

userStories.title: Remove duplicate json3 format retry in caption fallback sequence
acceptanceCriteria: _preferred_formats list does not contain duplicate entries
Caption format fallback sequence is json3->vtt->srt (no trailing json3)
Test verifies exactly 3 format attempts for videos where all formats fail
Test verifies _preferred_formats is a list/tuple without duplicates
Logging shows 'All formats exhausted' after srt fails (not after json3 retry)
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented: _preferred_formats=['json3','vtt','srt'] with no duplicates (line 2361). Added 'All formats exhausted' debug log (line 4602). Tests verify: no duplicates (test_no_duplicate_formats_in_preferred_list), exactly 3 attempts (test_each_format_tried_once_on_format_unavailable), sequence is json3->vtt->srt (test_format_sequence_no_repeat_json3), exhausted log appears (test_all_formats_exhausted_logged_after_srt_fails). 27 tests passing in test_caption_format_unavailable.py.

userStories.title: Add negative cache entry for videos with no captions available
acceptanceCriteria: When --list-subs returns empty, store negative cache entry with video_id
Negative cache entries use configurable TTL (default 1 hour)
Subsequent requests for same video_id check negative cache before network call
Negative cache hit logs 'Negative cache hit: no captions' and returns immediately
Test verifies 0 yt-dlp calls for negative-cached video
Test verifies negative cache expires after TTL
userStories.notes: All 6 criteria verified. Implementation in src/caption/cache.py (ListSubsCache.store stores empty lists, ListSubsCache.get_languages logs 'Negative cache hit: no captions' line 1163, is_no_captions_available checks negative cache). TTL configurable via ttl_hours param (default 1 hour). Tests in tests/test_listsubs_cache.py::TestListSubsNegativeCache - test_zero_ytdlp_calls_for_negative_cached_video (line 382) and test_negative_cache_expires_after_ttl (line 412). All 28 negative cache tests passing.

userStories.title: Add auto-generated caption fallback when manual captions unavailable
acceptanceCriteria: When manual captions unavailable, try --write-auto-sub as fallback
Auto-generated fallback is configurable via config.download.caption_first.use_auto_generated
Selection reason logged as 'auto-generated fallback' in metrics
Test verifies auto-generated captions fetched when manual unavailable
Test verifies auto-generated fallback disabled when config is false
Metrics track count of videos using auto-generated vs manual captions
userStories.notes: All 6 criteria verified. Tests in tests/test_caption_auto_fallback.py: test_manual_fail_falls_back_to_auto (AC1), test_auto_fallback_respects_config_false/true via allow_auto_generated config (AC2), test_auto_fallback_logs_selection_reason with 'auto-generated fallback' (AC3), test_auto_only_video_returns_auto_result (AC4), test_auto_fallback_respects_config_false verifies fallback disabled when config false (AC5), test_auto_fallback_records_metrics and test_no_metrics_when_manual_succeeds for metrics (AC6). 15 tests passing.

userStories.title: Add caption circuit breaker to prevent retry loops on systemic failures
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionCircuitBreaker class tracks consecutive failures across videos
Circuit opens after 5 consecutive failures, blocking further fetches for cooldown period
Circuit half-opens after cooldown, allowing single probe request
Successful probe closes circuit; failed probe re-opens it
CaptionRetryBudget.circuit_breaker reference set for observability (US-40-011)
Test verifies circuit trips after threshold failures
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented. CaptionCircuitBreaker exists in src/caption/circuit_breaker.py with all features: tracks consecutive failures (state.consecutive_failures), opens at threshold (default 10, configurable), half-opens after cooldown (check_and_wait), success closes/failure re-opens (record_success/record_failure). Added retry_budget.circuit_breaker linking in src/stages/caption_stage.py line 306-310. Tests: test_circuit_trips_at_5_failures_with_threshold_5, test_retry_budget_circuit_breaker_reference_observable, test_retry_budget_summary_includes_circuit_breaker_state in tests/test_caption_circuit_breaker.py (54 tests passing).

All 5 tests passing in TestCaptionStageNoCaptionsStatusPropagation: test_caption_result_has_no_captions_available_field, test_caption_result_has_fetch_error_field, test_stage_summary_shows_separate_no_captions_and_fetch_failed_counts, test_no_captions_videos_marked_for_transcription_cleanly, test_no_captions_not_treated_as_error.

userStories.title: Add per-format exhaustion tracking to caption retry budget
acceptanceCriteria: CaptionRetryBudget.format_attempts tracks attempts/failures/successes per format
is_format_exhausted returns true when format exceeds max_format_failures threshold
budget_exhausted accepts optional format parameter for per-format check
When format exhausted, skip that format in future attempts (try next in sequence)
Test verifies format skipped after max_format_failures failures
Summary includes format-level stats in get_summary output
userStories.notes: All 6 criteria verified. AC1-3 pre-existed from US-59-010 (retry_budget.py:156, 373-392, 404-469). AC4: Added is_format_exhausted check to _fetch_subtitle_formats loop (caption_fetcher.py:4583-4598) - exhausted formats now skipped with debug log. AC5: Added 3 new tests in test_format_budget_tracking.py::TestFormatSkippingInCaptionFetcher - test_exhausted_format_skipped_in_fetch_loop, test_all_formats_exhausted_returns_none, test_format_not_skipped_without_retry_budget. AC6: get_summary includes format_attempts (line 897). 31 tests passing.

userStories.notes: All 6 criteria verified. AC1: _add_bypass_args_to_cmd adds --impersonate flag to all yt-dlp calls (caption_fetcher.py:2433-2455). AC2: get_next_target() called for each call via ImpersonationManager.get_impersonate_args() or direct get_next_target() (caption_fetcher.py:2448). AC3: _handle_impersonation_failure records failures on 403/rate-limit triggering rotation (caption_fetcher.py:5224-5271).
